request.query: supremum over two independently constrained variables

items.name: sSup_image2
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {f : β → γ → α} {s : Set β} {t : Set γ},
  sSup (Set.image2 f s t) = ⨆ a ∈ s, ⨆ b ∈ t, f a b

items.name: iSup_prod'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : CompleteLattice α] (f : β → γ → α),
  ⨆ i, ⨆ j, f i j = ⨆ x, f x.1 x.2

items.name: iSup_and'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {p q : Prop} {s : p → q → α},
  ⨆ (h₁ : p), ⨆ (h₂ : q), s h₁ h₂ = ⨆ (h : p ∧ q), s ⋯ ⋯

items.name: iSup_prod
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} [inst : CompleteLattice α] {f : β × γ → α}, ⨆ x, f x = ⨆ i, ⨆ j, f (i, j)

items.name: biSup_sigma'
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : ι → Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : CompleteLattice β] (s : Set ι) (t : (i : ι) → Set (α i))
  (f : (i : ι) → α i → β), ⨆ i ∈ s, ⨆ j ∈ t i, f i j = ⨆ ij ∈ s.sigma t, f ij.fst ij.snd
